extraction.name: NWPU-RESISC45
extraction.description: A large-scale benchmark dataset for remote sensing image scene classification containing 31,500 images, covering 45 scene classes with 700 images in each class.
extraction.creator: Northwestern Polytechnical University (NWPU); Gong Cheng, Junwei Han, and Xiaoqiang Lu
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was extracted from Google Earth by experts in remote sensing image interpretation, covering more than 100 countries and regions.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Google Earth (Google Inc.) that maps the Earth by the superimposition of images obtained from satellite imagery, aerial photography and geographic information system (GIS) onto a 3D globe.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images were sized to 256x256 pixels in the RGB color space.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Images were manually extracted and categorized into 45 scene classes by experts in remote sensing image interpretation.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Experts in the field of remote sensing image interpretation.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The classes of island, lake, mountain, and snowberg have lower spatial resolutions compared to the rest of the dataset. Additionally, relying solely on traditional overhead remote sensing imagery makes it difficult to capture the detail and vertical characteristics of ground objects compared to ground photos.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and evaluating data-driven algorithms, specifically deep learning-based methods for scene classification.
